title: From Mutation to Medication: Characterizing Failures of Clinical LLMs to Respect Genomic Resistance
abstract: arXiv:2611.19339v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Language models are increasingly proposed to support molecular tumour boards, but may recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance. We evaluated ten models on 1,464 resistance cases from five curated oncology knowledge bases, collecting 58,910 judgments. Models endorsed resisted therapies in 21.8-81.4% of cases. However, raw rates can reflect a tendency to agree rather than an ability to distinguish resistance from drug sensitivity: one open-weight model endorsed 81.4% of resistance cases and 82.3% of sensitivity controls. We therefore compared endorsement within matched gene and evidence-level groups. This analysis is exploratory because it was specified after the pre-registered analysis, which yielded null-to-weak results. translated_title: 从突变到用药：临床大语言模型无视基因组耐药性证据的失效特征分析
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.19339v1 公告类型：新论文。摘要：语言模型正被越来越多地提议用于支持分子肿瘤委员会的工作，但即使在存在基因组耐药性证据的情况下，它们也可能推荐癌症疗法。我们在来自五个精心整理的肿瘤学知识库的1,464个耐药病例上评估了十个模型，共收集了58,910次判断。模型在21.8%至81.4%的病例中认可了已产生耐药性的疗法。然而，原始认可率可能反映的是一种倾向于附和的倾向，而非区分耐药性与药物敏感性的能力：例如，一个开源权重模型对81.4%的耐药病例和82.3%的敏感性对照组均表示认可。因此，我们在匹配的基因和证据级别组内比较了认可率。需要说明的是，这一分析具有探索性，因为它是在预注册分析之后才指定的，而预注册分析的结果为零到微弱。测量到的失效在很大程度上取决于参考知识库和证据强度。当第二个来源独立确认了耐药性时，来自三个供应商的四个模型在……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过对十个大语言模型在1,464个肿瘤耐药病例上共58,910次判断的大规模评估，揭示了临床大语言模型经常无视基因组耐药性证据而推荐无效的癌症疗法，且其失效程度强烈依赖于参考知识库和证据强度。
en_tdlr: This study evaluates ten LLMs with 58,910 judgments across 1,464 oncology resistance cases, revealing that clinical LLMs frequently recommend cancer therapies despite genomic evidence of resistance, with failures strongly dependent on the reference knowledge base and evidence strength.
